### Which file should I download?

- **Windows** (normal install): `ManageFreak-Setup-1.2.0.exe`
- **Windows** (nothing to install): `ManageFreak-1.2.0-portable.exe`
- **macOS Apple Silicon** (M1/M2/M3/M4): `ManageFreak-1.2.0-arm64.dmg`
- **macOS Intel**: `ManageFreak-1.2.0.dmg`
- **Linux**: `ManageFreak-1.2.0.AppImage`, or `managefreak_1.2.0_amd64.deb` for Debian/Ubuntu

If you already have 1.1.0 or 1.1.1 installed, you do not need any of these: the app updates
itself from its menu (top-left). The other files (`*.blockmap`, `latest*.yml`, macOS `.zip`)
are support files for the automatic updater.

---

## Added in 1.2.0

- **Listen to presets from your library (audition)**: the ▶ button plays it on the MicroFreak: the preset is written to a scratch slot you choose in the dedicated Audition options, that slot is selected, and a note is played. Scratch slot (*Init* slots suggested), note (C3–C6) and note length are configurable; the slot is copied before the first listen and can be restored.
- **Undo** (`↩ Undo`, `Ctrl+Z`): you can undo the last 5 operations such as presets written to slots, slots reset to *Init*, batch volume changes, wavetables, samples, and also everything done to the PC library (deletions, reordering, edits, imports). Confirmation lists exactly what will be touched.
- **Drag several presets at once, in both directions**: library → synth and synth → library (all the selected slots are imported, with progress bar, Cancel, and insertion where you dropped them).
- **Send the whole library to the MicroFreak**: you can now send an entire library to the MicroFreak and choose the starting slot. The menu lists every slot that will be written, together with the preset currently there that will be replaced.
- **Support the project**: the top-left menu has a new button to donate.

## Fixed in 1.2.0

- Dialogs no longer close when you release the mouse outside the window while selecting text.
- Now _Send the whole library to the MicroFreak_ starts from the library you are looking at.
- Drag & drop indicators line up at any interface zoom, not only at 100%.
- The drop target is now highlighted on _Init_ and _empty_ slots.
- Long button and label texts are correctly truncated when reduced in length.
- _Set volume_ dialog now has clearer indications.
- The toggle _Select the preset on the synth after writing_ now also selects the slot row on the MicroFreak and scrolls it into view.
- The changelog in the top-left menu now renders the markdown syntax correctly.
- The top-left menu is now bigger and resizable by dragging the corner. Size is remembered (double-click to reset).

---

### Notes

- ManageFreak is **unofficial** and not affiliated with Arturia.
- **Windows**: the installer is not code-signed, so SmartScreen may warn you:
  *More info → Run anyway*.
- **macOS**: the app is not signed or notarized; the README explains how to open it anyway.
- The macOS and Linux builds are provided but have not been tested on real hardware yet:
  if something is broken there, please report it.
- Found a problem? Please report it on GitHub or in the Reddit thread.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/GiovanniBitbyBit/managefreak/compare/v1.1.1...v1.2.0
